review_authority: User recalls CPU-only detailed review and factual report for the existing V13 MD/CD sequential task. This does not resume experiment submissions or long monitoring.
first_action: ACK same nonce as review owner. Verify actual session/CWD/repo and exact submission/source/job owner. One bounded accounting/status snapshot of exact3jobs, then CPU read/reduction of existing outputs. Last known RUNNING/PENDING is historical only, not current.
terminal_boundary: If terminal, audit available full/partial artifacts and report. If any arm still runs/pends, review sealed completed prefix as of bounded snapshot, explicitly mark W20 and ongoing stages NOT_AVAILABLE/NOT_OBSERVED, leave runner unchanged and stop without terminal polling/wait.

review_scope.identity: Full source/config/lock/runtime/native closure, case schedule first2000/order/seed/token identities/evaluator and arm mapping; distinguish production/registration/review source. Reuse unchanged huge model asset priorSHA+freshstat; no repeated fullmodel/CP hash merely for CPU review.
review_scope.completion: Per arm expected20commit/2000requests/19ownstatejoins/100Happend; actual prefix and fit counters. Exact W/H/RNG/context/ledger links, transaction finish/rollback, fresh entry/cache/upperactualkeys, historyrewrite-only once. No missing-aszero or crossarm state assumptions.
review_scope.metrics: Re-reduce original R/P/N candidate NLL/TF rows with strict inequality/tiesfail, finite/cardinality/case-prompt-target/order identity. Currentpre/post, W5/10/15/20allseen and finalR2000P4000N20000 if present. RS/PS/NS plus harmonic score; TFstrict/tokenmicro/promptmacro; true/new/desiredNLL,margins,tails.
review_scope.retention: Atwrite→latest/cohort/first100/first500 and own W0-correctN lost/gained/retention; active/superseded defined by seenprefix, no future leaks. MD/CD paired at same actual endpoint/sample/denominator; mismatched or absent raw NOT_AVAILABLE.
review_scope.realization: Native mean/canonical/rewrite/KL directionalratio,normratio,cosine,relativeerror/shares; local action vs inheritedgap vs netentry; zero-owner leakage, rank/range compatibility, targetprojection/rangeLS, ideal/effectiveQ/update norm by layer/batch. Finite rangeLS is scientific outcome, not rerun failure. Separate realization from edit/locality quality.
review_scope.comparison: New MD/CD owntrajectory curves and matched milestones; priorB1 and already available v12/MEMIT-H/AlphaEdit/BLUE baseline only when identity/cohort/endpoint verified. Label runtime/hardware/precision/planner differences historical, not matchedcausal; no newbaseline/evaluation/rawbroadcast.
review_scope.cost: Exact parent allocatedGPU-sec perarm, collectorCPU-GPU0, measuredfit/writer/observer/wall/VRAM/RSS/storage and unseparatedcomponents. No doublecountsteps/nestedtimes; pendingelapsed not allocatedGPU. PreviousB1 cost separate. NoCP/exact_resumeNOT_AVAILABLE.
review_scope.limitations: CPU independent reducer/source-owner audit levels honest; no actual model rebuild or tensor replay claims. Actual technical records distinct from new CPU tests. Existing numerical policy unchanged; record warnings, no syntheticPASS. No scientificpromotion/methodselection.

resources.CPU_review: Existing host CPU resources, no scheduler allocation or global config mutation

red_team_gate.preflight: Owner/session/exactjobidentity/read-onlyscope/sourcebinding; block ambiguity or accidental new computation.
red_team_gate.postreview: Separate CPU reducer vs stored aggregates, exact identity sets and state links, cost/manifest/report table/link checks; honest reviewer provenance, warn/negativeoutcomes disclosed not filtered.

artifact_policy: Raw/tensor/model/prompt/fullstdout stay local KEEP. Source+compact report/countCSV/figures/SHAmanifest only ownscopeGit. NO_BROADCAST_NOT_REQUIRED documented when no transfer needed. No oldbytes deletion/normalization.
publication: Under existing parent ownscope report permission, generate detailed Korean report/compact comparisonCSV/figures/reducer and manifests in clean dedicated branch. Nonforce ownbranch+main integration preserving concurrentGH/SH changes. Do not edit frozen production algorithm/optimizer/launchers or use review as a hotpatch.
monitoring: Bounded task recall/read once; no repeated scheduler/log/result polling, no waiting for running jobs, recurring automation/heartbeat/automaticretry=0. After factual report/main/compactGHhandoff REVIEW_COMPLETE_STOP; programs otherwise unchanged.
handoff: GH obtains direct owner ACK only, not experimentcompletion. SH4 autonomously performs this review and reports exact current coverage/findings/mainSHA. GH transportclosure is not task interruption.
